entries.en: I told you to go the hell away.
Allow me to reintroduce myself. Parasini, Noveria Internal Affairs.
How can I help you?
One moment, please. Mr. Anoleis?
Yes. What? What!
Commander Shepard is asking to see you, sir.
Right, fine. Come in.
We're aware of the rumors. At the moment, contact with the facility is down due to weather.
Mr. Anoleis isn't the only one with a pass to leave Hanshan.
Qui'in spends his days at the hotel since his office was closed.
Very well.
Weapons detectors. Don't mind the alarms.
I am Gianna Parasini, assistant to Administrator Anoleis. We apologize for the incident in the docking bay.
One of my duties is orientation of new arrivals. Do you have any questions?
The Executive Board does everything in its power to protect the privacy of our client corporations.
This planet is beyond the jurisdiction of the Citadel. The law is what the Executive Board says it is.
Do you know how valuable this planet is? How many advances in genetics and artificial intelligence got their start here?
Tread lightly. The Board can bury you in litigation. You'd need an asari lawyer to see the case through.
Unusual? An asari Matriarch passed through a few days ago. Lady Benezia.
His office is on the main level. Left at the top of the elevator.
Of course. If you need any help, you can ask me at the administrator's office.
You're welcome. You understand our security chief was only doing her job.
She takes her job seriously. She is a valuable asset to the company.
I'd like to speak to Anoleis.
Tell me about the companies that work on Noveria.
I hear there was an accident on Peak 15.
You said I should talk to Lorik Qui'in.
Nothing right now, thank you.
Pretty heavy security for such a small port.
I can't have my investigation hampered.
Is this "privacy" intended to hide illegal research?
Has anyone unusual passed through here recently?
Where can I find the administrator?
Understood. Can we go in now?
I appreciate your help.
Someone piss in your security chief's coffee today?
I have urgent business here.
Spectre. Have you given any more consideration to my offer?
The Executive Board knows about Anoleis' corruption. I've been undercover for six months.
I want you to convince Qui'in to testify before the Board. With his evidence, this planet can run profitably again.
I'm Anoleis' secretary. You think he'd believe me? That he'd meet me in some dark alley with his evidence?
He's a crook, not a moron. He doesn't keep logs on his computer saying, "This month I stole three million credits."
Qui'in's testimony and records are everything I need to prove Anoleis' guilt in one package.
You help my investigation, I'll provide whatever you need. Favor for a favor.
Before the weather closed in, Hanshan received a Code Omega signal from them.
Code Omega means a terminal breach of safety protocols. No one goes up until the crew sends an all-clear.
That's all I've got. No one knows what's going on up there.
Something to do with Peak 15. She arrived after we received their Code Omega -- automated warning of a containment breach.
She came with an escort of asari commandos. They took the last shuttle up to Peak 15 with a load of crates.
The shuttles are down, so you'd have to drive up. If you get Qui'in to testify, I'll get you into the garage.
Thank you. You know where I work. Come talk to me once you know if he'll play ball.
I can produce a copy of Anoleis' pass for you. I can't move large sums of money without someone noticing.
If you have any love for the law, you'll talk to Qui'in for me. Don't disappoint me.
Yes, yes. Fate of billions and all that. I couldn't possibly understand how important your work is.
Act natural. You want to blow my cover?
You're meeting a beautiful woman for drinks. Smile and laugh. Pretend we're flirting.
We're two friends who haven't seen each other since college. Remember that time so-and-so did that thing? Ha ha!
Over two hundred fifty high-tech firms rent our labs. Major shareholders include Elanus Risk Control Services, Binary Helix, and Synthetic Insights, Ltd.
The Executive Board gets a discount on facilities security. Elanus also develops lethal and non-lethal weapons.
BH is a leader in genetics and biotechnology. They try to keep a low profile in the media.
Much of their research is in biotic modifications. That angers many Luddite, organic-baseline, and fundamentalist groups.
They're one of only four corporations licensed by the Citadel Council to develop artificial intelligence.
They attract many protests. No agitators have ever breached our security. That's why they invest heavily here.
Not at all, Spectre. This is my job, after all.
All employees should review their non-disclosure agreements, and avoid irresponsible free talk.
Binary Helix has leased the entire complex.
A blizzard is sweeping the Skadi Mountains right now. Between the cloud cover and heavy snow, the satellite uplinks are cut.
"Loose lips sink third quarter profits."
You have a more blunt way of speaking than is common here, Commander.
We have seventeen research complexes built into the mountains. Each is a self-sufficient facility housing a staff of hundreds.
What do you want?
Why don't you ask Qui'in directly?
You work for Anoleis. Can't you just take his records?
I need Qui'in's garage pass to complete my mission.
You gave me the company line about Peak 15. What's the truth?
What's happening up on Peak 15?
That doesn't tell me much.
Do you know why the Matriarch is here?
How can I get to Peak 15?
All right. I'll talk to Qui'in and see if I can convince him.
I'll keep Qui'in's evidence.
Qui'in is offering to pay me. Can you?
I'll consider it and get back to you.
If your Executive Board loses a few million credits, it's not my problem. I have my own mission.
Why is an Internal Affairs agent here?
I don't have time for pleasantries.
Your guards work for ERCS, don't they?
Binary Helix? They work in genetics?
Haven't I seen Synthetic Insights in the news lately?
I've taken up enough of your time.
What corporations work on Peak 15?
What kind of weather cuts modern communications?
So, "everyone shut up and keep your heads down?"
How large are the facilities here?
Well, you sure proved me wrong. My lack of faith in Spectres was entirely unjustified.
Well, pardon me all to hell for expecting you to do your job!
It's hard to be patient this close to the end. I can't wait to work in real clothes again. You have any idea how much I hate skirts?
Anoleis is dirty. It might be best to help her.
Seems we'd help more people if we did as she asks.
In the long run, it is better to remove the source of the problem.
Your call, Commander, but I say we help.
Lorik is offering a lot of money. A pass can open one door. Credits can open many.
Where have you been? Have you made any progress with Qui'in?
I'm going to close my eyes and count to ten. If I don't explode, tell me if you've convinced Qui'in to turn over his evidence and testify. One... fourteen...
Do you still have Qui'in's evidence? Will he testify?
You what? [sigh] I should have known. Spectres always do whatever the hell they want.
So you got what you need. Do you still have Qui'in's evidence? Will you talk to him for me? I can still present the evidence to the Board.
[sigh] That's a world of stress off my back. I'll take the evidence for safe transport.
I didn't think you'd help me. Being a Spectre and all. I guess some of you can be all right.
Uh, not so fast, hero. You need to get into the garage, don't you? To head up to Peak 15?
I'm ecstatic. But right now, I just feel like a long day of work is ending.
While you were working on Qui'in, I got you a garage pass. Be careful up there.
I have an arrest to make. Wish I had time to change into something easy to move in. I hate skirts.
Sorry. I'm used to having my guard up. When people find out I'm Internal Affairs, they treat me like a traitor.
This was the best opportunity I've had in-- Why did you sell it?
That's a real good excuse. You've got the job, you should do it right.
You're kidding. Do you have any-- WHAT THE HELL WERE YOU THINKING!
I would have helped you, too. It might have taken longer, but is that a reason to let a guilty man walk?
I shouldn't have expected any better from a Spectre. You never give a damn about anything beyond your assignment.
Oh, right. Qui'in's evidence. Forgot all about it.
I got what I needed in my own way.
I need to get to Peak 15. The shortest route was a straight line.
I needed to get to Peak 15. The shortest route was a straight line.
Language, miss.
Frankly, your self-righteous attitude pissed me off.
I need more time. Be patient.
You're too late. I already gave Qui'in his evidence.
You're too late. I already gave Anoleis the evidence.
I gave Qui'in his evidence a while back.
I gave Anoleis the evidence some time ago.
I used the evidence to "persuade" Anoleis to let me go to Peak 15.
I'll ask him. Be patient a little longer.
It took some persuasion, but Qui'in has agreed to testify.
I'll leave you to your work.
Doesn't this help you? You don't seem particularly happy.
So how about getting me into the garage?
That's some gratitude you've got there.
I decided to take Qui'in's reward. Sorry.
I never signed up to be a Spectre. I was drafted.
Anoleis paid me for it. Tough luck.
Oh, yeah, that.
The situation is resolved.
Anoleis has the evidence.
Goodbye.
Then our business is done.
I thought you'd be happier.
What about the garage?
Yeah, you're welcome.
I never asked to be a Spectre.
I need to get to Peak 15.
I needed to get to Peak 15.
No need to yell.
I don't like you.
What do you want?
Why are you here?
I don't have time for this.
Qui'in has the evidence.
Anoleis has the evidence.
You can't do this yourself?
Your job
I need Qui'in's pass.
Like I care?
I'll help you.
No, I won't help you.
Pay me.
I'll consider it.
Peak 15 accident
Peak 15 accident
Matriarch Benezia
Reach Peak 15
That's all you know?
Where's Anoleis?
Lorik Qui'in
Goodbye.
Corporations
Peak 15
Lab facilities
Elanus Risk Control
Binary Helix
Synthetic Insights
Goodbye.
Who has offices on Peak 15?
Weather? You're joking.
You're ignoring the problem.
Thanks for getting us through.
Yeah, real friendly.
We're in a hurry.
Why so many guards?
I heard there were geth here.
Goodbye.
I may have to step on toes.
Sounds suspicious.
Where's Anoleis?
I gave Qui'in his evidence.
I gave Anoleis the evidence.
I blackmailed Anoleis.
Give me time.
I convinced Qui'in.
I gave the evidence to Qui'in.
Benezia--? She is here?
Benezia left for the Peak 15 research complex days ago. To the best of my knowledge, she's still there.
You'll need to ask Administrator Anoleis for clearance to leave this port.
The Board doesn't like having outside problems dumped in its lap, Commander.
Saren's aide is here?
Saren's second-in-command. She's here?
Saren's right hand? She's here?
Saren's flunky? Where?
"Passed through?" Where is she now?
That's where I need to be, then.
Could you tell me how to get there?
Good. Give us directions, and we'll be on our way.
Can I speak with her?
She's a threat to galactic peace. I'm here to bring her in or put her down.
She left?
I need to talk to her.
She's a dead woman.
Then I'm going there.
I'll need directions.
I'll require your cooperation.
No idea. The commandos wouldn't let anyone near them. They seemed heavy, though.
The rule is "don't rock the boat." Self-interest is tolerated if it doesn't interfere with business. Anoleis is driving customers away.
Do you know what she had in the crates?
I thought corruption was the rule on Noveria.
Corruption
What was in the crates?
The Executive Board votes whether or not to destroy the facility. One antimatter warhead from the battlestations vaporizes all contaminants.
You know where I work. Come talk to me when you change your mind.
That's gratifying to hear.
I don't believe this. You've ruined a--
And if the crew never sends an all-clear?
I'm not here to dig out any corporate secrets.
What if there's no all-clear?
I'm not here for them.
Look, Shepard. I don't like this either. You Spectres play fast and loose with the law. That's bad for business.
While I'm young, Shepard.
Son of a bitch! This is what I get for entrusting it to a Spectre. What'd you do -- hold a gun to his head and order him to do it? God.
Get out of here. I need to see if I can salvage anything from this. I do not want to spend another six months wearing this outfit.
Pff. You know what? Forget it. I should have known better. Spectres never care about anything beyond their mission.
You underestimated Noveria's code of silence. Qui'in wouldn't rock the boat, no matter what assurance I offered.
He wouldn't testify.
Hurry it up already.
I've got a lot of work to do.
Fly off and cause problems for someone else.
She is here. I can't believe it.
Commander? Maybe we should tell Liara that her mother's here. Or bring her along. Maybe she can reason with Benezia.
Commander? Maybe we ought to tell Liara that her mom's here. Or bring her along. It might take Benezia off-guard.
Commander, it might be wise to bring Dr. T'Soni along. She knows her mother better than any of us.
If Lady Benezia is here, it might be wise to bring Liara along. She knows her mother better than we do.
All right.  I'll talk to Qui'in and see if I can convince him.
I'll help you.
You've never worked in the corporate world, have you, Commander? You can't bludgeon through bureaucracy.
Talk to Lorik Qui'in. You should be able to find him at the hotel bar.
Can't say more. Not within earshot of Mr. Anoleis.
So it would seem. I need an alternative.
I can bludgeon pretty hard.
All right. What would you do?
I can see that.
Don't underestimate me.
What do you suggest?
I'd like to help you, Miss Parasini, but I need Qui'in's garage pass. It's vital to my mission.
I have my own mission.
I'll talk to him.
Get off my back.
I don't think Qui'in will agree to testify. Can't you just take the evidence?
I doubt Qui'in will help.
Thank you. You know where I work. Come talk to me once you know if he'll play ball.
I needed to get to Peak 15.
I need to get to Peak 15.
I blackmailed Anoleis.
I gave Qui'in his evidence.
I gave Anoleis the evidence.
Talk to you later.
Goodbye.
I don't have time for this.
I have a mission to complete.
I'm a little busy now.
I don't think you're supposed to be in here, Shepard.
Oh, now you're going to show some respect?
Leave? You think I'm going to let you walk out? Uh-uh.
I'm Sergeant Kaira Stirling, Elanus Risk Control Services.
Anoleis would throw you offworld for what you did here. I won't. You know what we did to cop killers on my world?
Your men are dirty, Sergeant. You're here off-duty, breaking the law for bribe money.
You're breaking the law for bribe money. You know what we do to dirty cops on my world?
What a load of crap. You're here off-duty, breaking the law for bribe money.
Being a cop doesn't give you the right to break the law yourself. You accepted bribe money.
You're here off-duty, breaking the law for bribe money. You expect us to feel bad for stopping you?
Well, I don't need a gun to rip you to pieces.
You talk the talk. Let's see if you can walk after I break your legs.
I don't care.
Get out of here.
I'll be keeping my eye on you.
You're not so tough.
You better toe the line here.
You have me at a disadvantage, Miss...?
Do you plan on making me leave?
No, I'm not. Are you?
I didn't want to fight them. They fired first.
If you want a fight, I'll give you one.
I have a mission to complete. I did what I had to.
Who are you?
Your point?
Nope.
They didn't give me a choice.
Bring it on.
I'm on a mission.
I have a lot of paperwork to do here. If you don't mind?
Commander. I am glad you stopped to talk.
I wanted to tell you how unfortunate it was that Anoleis-sama was caught with his hand in the cookie jar. Rest assured, I bear you no ill will.
The Executive Board is not concerned with galactic law, Commander. That's why this planet was settled, after all.
As far as they are concerned, Anoleis-sama went too far. On Noveria, you may do what you wish, so long as you do not disturb public order.
I only request that you limit the number of disturbances you provoke. I would consider it a favor.
I appreciate that, Commander.
If you will excuse me, I must file reports on this incident. Good day.
Of course. These things happen.
I see. That makes your position clear enough.
Bluntly stated, but not untrue. As a Spectre, you can do as you see fit.
Good day, Commander. I trust you are behaving yourself? Not mixing yourself up in any questionable activities?
No, of course. I thought you'd be too intelligent for such a thing.
If you were, I would have to recite some tedious speech, then ask you to leave. Just so we understand each other.
I'm merely interested in the loading and off-loading of cargos. Particularly those involving potentially illegal goods.
I am rather busy preparing funeral arrangements.
Good day, Commander. I wonder, how have you been spending your time?
That's a polite way to brush me off. No matter.
There was a break-in at the Synthetic Insights office. Several of my officers were killed. You wouldn't know anything, would you?
I see. Would you care to explain?
That is all too likely. Sergeant Stirling was highly mercenary. If that is true, I bear no ill will toward you.
I warned my people against taking jobs on the side. This is what comes of it. I appreciate your honesty, Commander.
If you will excuse me, I must compose the letters to notify their families.
Thank you for saying that, but it does not bring them back.
I do not believe you are being honest with me. But in the absence of proof, I must accept your word.
That is not an answer. Not that I truly expected one.
So long as your actions don't cause public disturbance, I agree.
Is there anything I can do for you today, Commander?
You first. I'm just a security guard. I heard that there were no human Spectres. How did you get that job?
You disabled the nuke? That makes sense. Special Tactics likes people who can think on their feet.
I served in the marines for a decade, mustered out, and went private sector. I was under fire a few times, so I ended up leading this detail.
There have been a few stories on the extranet about that. People debating whether or not the Alliance will be given another chance.
Their answer to the lawlessness is to make one of us a Spectre and tell us to fix it ourselves? I bet the Terra Firma Party is having a field day with this.
You certainly know how to allay a peace officer's fears.
I suspected it might involve things you could not talk about. I have non-disclosure agreements, too.
I am sure Parasini-san gave you the ultra-special blah-blah about business here.
Everyone wants to be protected from everyone else. But everyone also thinks they have a special right to kick over everyone else.
Most of my job is diplomacy. Two corps start yelling at each other, my people walk in, flash some ceramic and they start talking civilly.
If there is anything this job has taught me, it is how to be impartial.
[sigh] Everything from hackers to mercenaries. They have investments to protect, after all. But we are the only ones allowed to bear arms.
Which is why the companies constantly try to bribe my people. I have a clear policy against freelancing. Anyone who works on the side is fired.
All of the companies have secrets. Some of them deal in things that are not quite legal.
Having a Spectre here makes them nervous. Anoleis-sama is buried under petitions to kick you offworld.
It would be more accurate to say we are here to prevent incidents between employees and your crew.
I am protecting them from themselves. They do not have the personnel or training to assault an Alliance frigate.
No doubt. I can count gun turrets as well as anyone else. But the backlash -- you would not want to deal with that.
Very good, Commander. Please stay out of trouble.
I apologize for my rudeness when you arrived. I meant no disrespect.
I have a responsibility to protect the safety and privacy of corporations here. The arrival of an Alliance warship was unexpected.
I hoped you might.
That is a generous attitude. My thanks.
Not at all. My actions were correct, based on the information I had at the time.
I am sure Parasini-san will answer any questions you have.
"Unfortunate?" He was a criminal, Captain.
I don't intend to make life difficult for anyone.
I'd like to give that promise, but I can't predict what I may have to do in the future.
Do what you have to do, Captain. I'll do the same.
It doesn't sound like you disapprove of his actions.
It doesn't matter if you approve or not.
I don't generally get involved in that sort of thing.
Why do you ask?
Hypothetically speaking, what would you do?
You know. Spectre business.
That was me, actually.
Anoleis bought them off. He had them ransacking the Synthetic Insights office for his own interests.
No innocent people died in that office. They were there on Anoleis' orders, to protect his interests.
Some of your people died? My sympathies.
No, I'm afraid I wouldn't.
I've tried to keep myself busy.
You know the expression "need-to-know basis?" You don't need to know.
Tell me about yourself.
My crew and I were involved in Saren's raid on Eden Prime.
I'm a test case. The Council wants to see if humans are ready to rejoin them.
They're throwing humanity a bone to shut us up about the problems in the Traverse.
The Spectres like people well-versed in killing. That'd be me.
I'd prefer to not talk about it. No offense.
There are guards everywhere. Are there that many problems here?
So you have to keep them from getting too eager.
Your job is preventing problems, not solving them.
Don't they have their own security forces?
Why are you still here? Are you guarding my ship?
So you're waiting here in case he makes that decision.
Then you're actually protecting Normandy from the companies.
I assure you my crew is quite capable of protecting our ship.
I'll be moving on.
I can understand how that would make people here nervous.
No harm was done.
Embarrassed to be put in your place?
He was a criminal.
Spectre business.
This and that.
None of your business.
I did it.
I'm sorry to hear that.
[LIE] Nope.
They were working for Anoleis.
They were corrupt.
Personal questions
Port security
Guarding Normandy
Goodbye.
We saved Eden Prime.
I'm a test case.
It's political B.S.
Body count.
I'd rather not discuss it.
You keep them all in line.
They have their own security?
You keep the corps in line.
You're waiting to kick us out.
You're protecting Normandy.
We can take care of ourselves.
I understand that.
Forget about it.
Humiliating, wasn't it?
Do you condone his actions?
Your opinion doesn't matter.
I'll do my best.
No promises.
We'll see.
Of course not.
Why?
What if I am?
I would be grateful if you would finish your business and leave.
There have been too many disturbances since you arrived.
I have work I must see to. If you don't mind?
They were breaking the law.
That's far enough.
You better hope there isn't.
Citadel authority supercedes yours.
We going to let them do this, Commander?
It would not be wise to search for the geth unarmed.
I'm Captain Maeko Matsuo, Elanus Risk Control Services.
I can't let you enter the port area without confirmation of your identity.
This is an unscheduled arrival. I need your credentials.
We will need to confirm that.
Also, I must advise you that firearms are not permitted on Noveria.
Don't try it.
Don't come crying to me when they slice your gut open.
Aye aye, Commander.
If you think this is best, commander.
I'll be behind you. That armor's in good condition?
Aye aye, Commander.
Colorful language is of little use against geth.
Why not?
We are authorized to use lethal force. You have to the count of three to surrender your weapons.
One. Two. Thr--
Captain Matsuo! Stand down.
We confirmed their identity. Spectres are authorized to carry weapons here, Captain.
You may proceed, Spectre. I hope the rest of your visit will be less confrontational.
Parasini-san will meet you upstairs.
Back away. Nice and slow.
Something wrong, Officer?
You first.
All you need to know is I have more credentials than you.
We're not here to cause problems.
I'm on important business.
I'm a Spectre. My name is Shepard.
Stand down. Their house, their rules.
Let's not start a fight.
Nobody takes my weapon.
Can I help you?
We'll cooperate.
Step aside.
I'm with the Council.
Who are you?
No.
We'll cooperate.
Easy, people.
I'm keeping my gun.
You're a long way from home, Commander.
Aren't we all?
Aren't we all?
Home is a state of mind.
You have no idea.
Commander Shepard, Systems Alliance Navy.
Alliance Navy.
Charge and lock!
Behave yourself.
Load of horsecrap, ma'am.
The next Navy patrol isn't due for another two weeks.
We're the law here. Show some respect.
They plan to be trouble, ma'am.
Sergeant Stirling, secure their weapons.
Captain Matsuo! Stand down.
I outrank you.
I imagine you want to talk to me, Shepard. About my mother.
My people have an expression, too. "Only a child never contradicts her mother."
I meant what I said before. Her actions are wrong.
If you would feel safer leaving me on the Normandy, I will stay. But I would like to see her. Maybe I can persuade her to come peacefully.
I understand. Please try to reason with her. She was a good person once.
Thank you, Shepard. That means a great deal to me.
No, I don't. I trust you, Liara. You may not be military, but you're part of my crew.
No, we don't. Humans have an expression: "Blood is thicker than water".
We talked about her before. But things change when you're up against something. If it's her or me, who would you shoot?
I hope so. I accept your word, Liara. Let's get going.
Pretty words, but I can't take the risk. Report back to the Normandy.
I don't think that's likely. But you can try.
Don't worry.
I can't trust you.
Can I trust you?
Come with us.
Go back to the ship.
You can try.
